spec.title: Soil Relative Wetness Index
spec.description: Experimental relative wetness index, not absolute soil moisture percentage

spec.query:
from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and
    r._field == "relative_wetness_pct" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01"
  )
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _field: "soil_condition",
    _value:
      if r._value < 17.0 then 0.0
      else if r._value < 20.0 then 1.0
      else if r._value < 70.0 then 2.0
      else 3.0
  }))
  |> yield(name: "soil_condition")

spec.title: AMG8833 - Thermal Pixel Matrix 8×8
spec.description: 8x8 Thermal Grid Heatmap using Grafana Built-in Table Panel

spec.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r._field =~ /^p[0-7][0-7]$/
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    row: int(v: strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 1, end: 2)),
    col: strings.substring(v: r._field, start: 2, end: 3),
    _value: r._value
  }))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["row"],
    columnKey: ["col"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> sort(columns: ["row"])
  |> drop(columns: ["row"]) // 🌟 เพิ่มบรรทัดนี้เพื่อลบคอลัมน์ row ออก

spec.title: Last Data Received
spec.description: Minutes since the latest Soil measurement was stored in InfluxDB

spec.query:
from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and
    r._field == "relative_wetness_pct" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01"
  )
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _value: float(
      v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)
    ) / 60000000000.0,
    _time: now(),
    _field: "minutes_since_last"
  }))

spec.title: PlantCare Historical Sensor Data
spec.description: Historical one-minute Soil and AMG8833 measurements

spec.query:
from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(
    start: v.timeRangeStart,
    stop: v.timeRangeStop
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.data_source == "real" and
    (
      r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" or
      r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal"
    )
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: 1m,
    fn: last,
    createEmpty: false
  )
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time", "plant_id", "device_id"],
    columnKey: ["_measurement", "_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> keep(columns: [
    "_time",
    "plant_id",
    "device_id",
    "plantcare_soil_soil_adc_raw",
    "plantcare_soil_soil_adc_filtered",
    "plantcare_soil_relative_wetness_pct",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_min_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_max_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_left_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_t_right_c",
    "plantcare_thermal_delta_t_c"
  ])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

samples =
  from(bucket: "plantcare")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.data_source == "real" and
      r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
      (
        (r._measurement == "plantcare_soil" and
         r._field == "relative_wetness_pct") or
        (r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
         r._field == "t_max_c")
      )
    )
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_measurement"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _field: if r._measurement == "plantcare_soil"
        then "Soil"
        else "Thermal",
      _value: 1.0
    }))
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

disconnections =
  samples
    |> elapsed(unit: 1s, columnName: "gap_s")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.gap_s > 180)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: time(v:
        uint(v: r._time) -
        uint(v: r.gap_s - 180) * uint(v: 1000000000)
      ),
      _field: r._field,
      _value: 0.0
    }))

current_disconnections =
  samples
    |> last()
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      uint(v: now()) >
      uint(v: r._time) + uint(v: 180000000000)
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: time(v:
        uint(v: r._time) + uint(v: 180000000000)
      ),
      _field: r._field,
      _value: 0.0
    }))

union(tables: [
  samples,
  disconnections,
  current_disconnections
])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "sensor_connectivity")

from(bucket: "plantcare")
  |> range(start: -3m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "plantcare_thermal" and
    r.data_source == "real" and
    r.device_id == "esp32_01" and
    (
      r._field == "t_max_c" or
      r._field == "delta_t_c"
    )
  )
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    exists r.t_max_c and
    exists r.delta_t_c
  )
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _field: "thermal_exposure",
    _value:
      if r.t_max_c >= 35.0 then 2.0
      else if r.delta_t_c >= 2.0 then 1.0
      else 0.0
  }))
  |> yield(name: "thermal_exposure")
